title: Inline Cache Evolution in V8
description: Observe the transition from Monomorphic to Megamorphic when a function receives heterogeneous Shapes.

steps.label: 1. Monomorphic (1 Shape)
steps.description: getX({ x: 1, y: 2 }) caches Shape_AB and reads offset +0 directly.

steps.label: 2. Polymorphic (2 to 4 Shapes)
steps.description: Calls with { x: 1, z: 3 } then { y: 2, x: 1 }: the IC maintains a small array of Shapes.

steps.label: 3. Megamorphic (> 4 Shapes)
steps.description: Beyond 4 distinct Shapes, the IC abandons the local cache and falls back to the global hash table.
